summary: Frontend testing completed for Al-Marooj Dairy ERP system. All requested features are working: 1) Welcome toast with logo after login, 2) Employee Scheduling page with 58 employees, 3) Supplier transfer dialog. Fixed critical backend route ordering issue for /hr/employees/work-schedules endpoint.

fixed.issue: Route was returning 404 because it was defined after /hr/employees/{employee_id} - FastAPI was matching 'work-schedules' as employee_id
fixed.fix: Moved the work-schedules route before the parameterized route in server.py

welcome_toast_with_logo.details: Large welcome toast with Al-Marooj Dairy logo appears after successful login. Shows 'مرحباً بك في المروج للألبان' with user name.

employee_scheduling_page.details: Page loads at /employee-scheduling with 58 employees. Shows shift stats (morning/afternoon/night), bulk edit functionality, individual edit dialogs with shift type and weekly off days selection.

supplier_transfer_dialog.details: Transfer button visible on each supplier row. Dialog opens with current center, new center dropdown, and transfer confirmation button.

sidebar_navigation.details: Sidebar shows 'جدولة الموظفين' (Employee Scheduling) link. Navigation between Dashboard, Suppliers, and Employee Scheduling works correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: Route ordering in FastAPI: Static routes like /hr/employees/work-schedules must be defined BEFORE parameterized routes like /hr/employees/{employee_id} to avoid incorrect matching
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py - Moved work-schedules endpoint before parameterized employee routes
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested features are working. Backend route fix was applied for /hr/employees/work-schedules. The app is RTL Arabic interface. Login credentials: yasir/admin123. Employee Scheduling page shows 58 employees with shift management. Suppliers page has 1000 suppliers with transfer functionality.
